text:
maya: Quick sync request — we had a support case where hosted fell back to dedicated and the audit trail was incomplete. Need to define what metadata/auth we preserve during hosted->ded/hosted->private fallbacks. cc @neha @ben

tj: We currently strip the full customer token on cross-mode fallbacks for safety, but that kills per-tenant billing and traceability :/

ben: runtime note: we can include opaque headers (tenant-hash, request-id) but private/onprem customers often require a token exchange (KMS/HSM constraints). Without a token broker the private side can't attribute actions to keys.

neha: From SRE perspective we need a consistent request_id, origin_zone, and explicit fallback_reason logged. Otherwise tracing and alerting on regressions is impossible.

olivia: Product question — customers expect RBAC/audit continuity. If we anonymize tokens we must still expose a non-reversible tenant identifier in audit logs so the customer can map events.

ada: Security: we cannot export long-lived keys. Proposal: control-plane mints short-lived delegation tokens inside customer VPC (token broker). Any propagated auth must be consented and auditable.

maya: Proposed minimal surface for fallbacks: 1) request_id 2) origin_zone 3) fallback_reason (enum) 4) tenant_hash (non-reversible) 5) model_variant list. Agree/disagree?

tj: SGTM. Need an example header set so adapters can be implemented consistently. Example: `X-RW-Req-Id`, `X-RW-Origin`, `X-RW-Fallback`, `X-RW-Tenant-Hash`

ben: Also add `X-RW-Auth-Flow` with values `delegation|shadow` to indicate whether we did a token mint or just proxied with masking. Runtime will behave differently.

neha: Observability: those headers must be captured in traces, metrics, and the per-route dashboards. Also emit a `fallback.count` metric with reason tag.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/adapter-handshake v2 -> staging (owner: ben)

maya: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short RFC. Can we agree on fallback_reason enums: `CAPACITY`, `MODEL_MISMATCH`, `AUTHZ_DENIED`, `PROGRESSIVE_ROLLOUT`?

ada: Add `SECURITY_REJECT` as an explicit enum when a security policy blocks propagation — different than AUTHZ_DENIED which may be authn/permission.

olivia: Also need to clarify billing semantics: hosted->dedicated fallback should by default bill to origin customer unless account has an override. That has to be explicit in the RFC.

tj: One more: config translation. Feature flags and limits differ by mode — include a `X-RW-Config-Profile` header that the adapter can use to map/translate settings.

maya: Action items: maya -> RFC draft (with header list), ben -> mock header schema + handshake pseudocode, neha -> observability mapping and metrics, ada -> token broker flow + security constraints. Meeting tomorrow 10:00 to walk through. I'll ping calendar.
